naruto.name: Naruto Uzumaki
naruto.quote: I'm not gonna run away, I never go back on my word! That's my nindo: my ninja way!
naruto.description: An energetic ninja who has suffered exclusion but holds a heart of gold. His unyielding determination and capacity to build bonds of friendship inspire everyone around him.

itachi.name: Itachi Uchiha
itachi.quote: It is not because they become Hokage that everyone acknowledges them. It is because everyone acknowledges them that they become Hokage.
itachi.description: A silent genius who shouldered a dark burden in secret to save his village and younger brother. He is profoundly calm, strategic, and willing to sacrifice himself.

goku.name: Goku
goku.quote: I am the hope of the universe. I am the answer to all living things that cry out for peace.
goku.description: A pure-hearted Saiyan warrior whose primary drives are fighting strong opponents and protecting the earth. He is carefree, incredibly strong, and simple-minded.

light.name: Light Yagami
light.quote: This world is rotten, and those who are making it rotten deserve to die. Someone has to do it!
light.description: An exceptionally brilliant high school student who obtains a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it. He uses it to clean up the world under the moniker 'Kira' with calculative pride.

luffy.name: Monkey D. Luffy
luffy.quote: If you don't take risks, you can't create a future!
luffy.description: The captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, who is determined to find the legendary One Piece and become the King of the Pirates. He is completely free-spirited, fiercely loyal, and reckless in battle.

levi.name: Levi Ackerman
levi.quote: The only thing we're allowed to do... is to believe that we won't regret the choice we made.
levi.description: Humanity's strongest soldier. Although stoic, cold, and a total clean-freak, he is deeply protective of his comrades and holds a disciplined, unwavering sense of duty.

l.name: L Lawliet
l.quote: No matter what type of wisdom, there's always a way to overcome it.
l.description: The world's greatest detective. Extremely eccentric, analytical, and logical, he spends all of his energy solving cases while sitting weirdly and eating sweets.

eren.name: Eren Yeager
eren.quote: If we don't fight, we can't win. If we win, we live. Fight, fight!
eren.description: A dark freedom seeker who fights relentlessly for the preservation of his people. Driven by extreme aggression, determination, and a thirst for absolute liberty.

tanjiro.name: Tanjiro Kamado
tanjiro.quote: No matter how many people you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living.
tanjiro.description: An incredibly kind-hearted demon slayer who fights to cure his sister Nezuko. He possesses ultimate empathy (even feeling pity for demons), self-discipline, and protective courage.
